messages:
claire_design: posted a new idea for an inline picker that preserves provenance without a big inspector. sketch: https://redwood.mock/s/inline-provenance-pick.png derek_devex: neat. can you summarize the provenance UI? i want to be sure audit info doesn't clutter the run row. claire_design: plan: tiny gray line under the run row: 'swapped: spellcheck -> advanced-lm by claire_design · 5m ago'. click the provenance to expand full audit modal if needed. picker itself is a small dropdown anchored to the run item. anya_a11y: accessibility flags: provenance text must be readable at 4.5:1; the expandable control needs an accessible name like "Show swap history for this run". if it's focusable, ensure keyboard users can open the history and escape to close. marcos_engineer: implementation notes: dropdown picker will lazy-fetch candidate tools, sorted by signal. we'll attach data-tool-id to each item. example HTML we can slot in: ```html
  • spellcheck
  • advanced-lm
``` kami_research: quick user-testing note: people want a reversible interaction. propose an inline "undo" affordance for 30s after swap. also track metric: swaps that are undone within 30s. claire_design: good call. copy suggestions: picker label = "Select tool"; provenance prefix = "swapped:"; toast after change: "Tool swap saved (undo)" with an Undo action. avoid wording like "apply" to prevent confusion about auto-run. derek_devex: prefer explicit toast CTA: "Undo" and secondary link "Rerun". telemetry event: tool_swap (from, to, actor, undone=false). anya_a11y: aria/live: when toast appears, use an assertive region: "Tool swapped from spellcheck to advanced-lm. Press U to undo." ensure the undo button is reachable by keyboard. also ensure that the provenance expand announces previous versions. marcos_engineer: backend: emit audit event and store in run object: {run_id: 1769990000, swaps: [{from: 'spellcheck', to: 'advanced-lm', by: 'claire_design', ts: 1769990000}]} (will be JSON in logs, UI reads only string summary). caching: keep tool metadata for 2 minutes. ops-bot: ops-bot: staging deploy queued for playground/inline-provenance (build 7210)
